title: DEMO-9: retry transient payment failures in shared client
content:
commit 0d6ba14 2026-11-20T03:46:22.000Z Likhith Vardhan Goruputi
DEMO-9: retry transient payment failures in shared client

Retry timeouts and 5xx responses, tighten the per-attempt timeout so a
slow attempt is abandoned quickly, and drop the fixed backoff.

libs/httpclient/__init__.py lines 44-113 in build b-1230 artifact checkout-svc-1.9.0-b-1230.tar (commit 0d6ba14)
  44 class ServiceClient:
  45     def __init__(self, base_url: str, tracer, metrics=None, peer: str = "",
  46                  timeout_ms: int | None = None, max_retries: int | None = None,
  47                  retry_on=None, backoff_ms: int | None = None):
  48         self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
  49         u = urlparse(self.base_url)
  50         self.host, self.port = u.hostname, u.port or 80
  51         self.tracer = tracer
  52         self.metrics = metrics
  53         self.peer = peer or self.host
  54         self.timeout_ms = timeout_ms if timeout_ms is not None else policy.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
  55         self.max_retries = max_retries if max_retries is not None else policy.MAX_RETRIES
  56         self.retry_on = tuple(retry_on if retry_on is not None else policy.RETRY_ON)
  57         self.backoff_ms = backoff_ms if backoff_ms is not None else policy.BACKOFF_MS
  58 
  59     def describe(self) -> dict:
  60         return {"base_url": self.base_url, "timeout_ms": self.timeout_ms,
  61                 "max_retries": self.max_retries, "retry_on": list(self.retry_on),
  62                 "backoff_ms": self.backoff_ms, "client_version": CLIENT_VERSION}
  63 
  64     def post_json(self, path: str, payload: dict) -> Response:
  65         body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
  66         attempt = 0
  67         while True:
  68             attempt += 1
  69             kind, detail, resp = self._attempt(path, body, attempt)
  70             if kind == "ok":
  71                 return resp
  72             retryable = (kind in self.retry_on) and attempt <= self.max_retries
  73             if not retryable:
  74                 if kind == "5xx":
  75                     return resp
  76                 if kind == "timeout":
  77                     raise ClientTimeout(f"timed out after {self.timeout_ms}ms", attempt)
  78                 raise ClientConnectionError(detail, attempt)
  79             if self.backoff_ms:
  80                 time.sleep(self.backoff_ms / 1000.0)
  81 
  82     def _attempt(self, path, body, attempt):
  83         if self.metrics:
  84             self.metrics.inc("upstream_attempts")
  85         with self.tracer.span(f"POST {path}", kind="client",
  86                               attributes={"peer.service": self.peer, "http.attempt": attempt,
  87                                           "http.timeout_ms": self.timeout_ms}) as sp:
  88             conn = http.client.HTTPConnection(self.host, self.port, timeout=self.timeout_ms / 1000.0)
  89             try:
  90                 conn.request("POST", path, body=body, headers={
  91                     "Content-Type": "application/json", "traceparent": sp.traceparent()})
  92                 r = conn.getresponse()
  93                 data = r.read()
  94                 sp.set("http.status_code", r.status)
  95                 resp = Response(r.status, data, attempt)
  96                 if r.status >= 500:
  97                     sp.fail(f"HTTP {r.status}")
  98                     if self.metrics:
  99                         self.metrics.inc("upstream_errors")
 100                     return "5xx", f"HTTP {r.status}", resp
 101                 return "ok", "", resp
 102             except (socket.timeout, TimeoutError):
 103                 sp.fail(f"timeout after {self.timeout_ms}ms")
 104                 if self.metrics:
 105                     self.metrics.inc("upstream_errors")
 106                 return "timeout", "timeout", None
 107             except (ConnectionError, OSError) as exc:
 108                 sp.fail(f"connect error: {exc}")
 109                 if self.metrics:
 110                     self.metrics.inc("upstream_errors")
 111                 return "connect_error", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}", None
 112             finally:
 113                 conn.close()
